title: How Do You Apply for a Hong Kong Visit Visa?
seo_title: Hong Kong Visit Visa Application: Forms, Documents and Steps
desc: How to apply for a Hong Kong visit visa: who needs one, forms ID 1003A and ID 1003B, documents, sponsors, processing time and the e-Visa you get.
alt: Hong Kong skyline across Victoria Harbour
faq: Is a Hong Kong visa the same as a China visa?
No. Hong Kong has its own immigration rules. A mainland China visa does not let you enter Hong Kong, and a Hong Kong visa does not let you enter mainland China.
Can I apply for a Hong Kong visit visa online?
Yes. The Hong Kong Immigration Department accepts visit and transit visa applications online through GovHK, and you can pay the fee by card.
Do I need a sponsor for a Hong Kong visit visa?
No, a sponsor is optional. It can make your application easier to verify, especially for family or business visits.
Can I work on a Hong Kong visit visa?
No. Visitors may not take paid or unpaid work, start or join a business, or enrol as students.
What does the Hong Kong e-Visa look like?
It is an electronic document with a QR code. Keep it on your phone or print it on A4 paper and show it with your passport at the immigration counter.
content:
Short answer: If your passport is not on Hong Kong's visa-free list, you apply for a visit visa from the Hong Kong Immigration Department (ImmD). You fill in form ID 1003A, attach your passport copy, a photo, proof of money and your travel plans, and submit it online, by post or through a Chinese embassy where you live. Processing normally takes about four weeks, and approved visitors get an e-Visa.

Quick factsDetails
Who decidesHong Kong Immigration Department (ImmD)
Applicant formID 1003A (visit/transit)
Sponsor formID 1003B (optional but helpful)
Where to applyOnline (GovHK), by post to ImmD, or at a Chinese diplomatic mission abroad
Normal processing timeAbout 4 weeks once the file is complete
What you receiveAn e-Visa (show it on your phone or on A4 paper)

What is a Hong Kong visit visa?

A Hong Kong visit visa is permission to enter Hong Kong for a short stay, such as tourism, visiting family, attending meetings or passing through. It does not allow you to work, study or start a business. Hong Kong runs its own immigration system, separate from mainland China, so a China visa does not cover Hong Kong and a Hong Kong visa does not cover the mainland.

Do you need a visa for Hong Kong?

Many nationalities can visit Hong Kong without a visa for 7 to 180 days. You need a visit visa if your nationality is not on that list, or if you want to stay longer than your visa-free period. Check your nationality on the ImmD "Visa Requirements for Visitors" page before you start. For example, Indian nationals have their own pre-arrival registration rules and apply directly to ImmD rather than through a Chinese embassy.

How do you apply for a Hong Kong visit visa, step by step?

  1. Check you need a visa. Look up your passport on the ImmD visa requirements list.
  2. Download form ID 1003A. It is free on the ImmD website. Fill it in with your passport details exactly as printed.
  3. Find a sponsor if you can. A Hong Kong company or a Hong Kong resident aged 18+ who knows you can fill in form ID 1003B. A sponsor is not compulsory, but it helps ImmD verify your visit.
  4. Collect your documents (see the list below).
  5. Submit the application. Apply online through GovHK, post it to ImmD Headquarters in Tseung Kwan O (directly or via your sponsor), or hand it in at the Chinese embassy or consulate where you live.
  6. Pay the fee. The current amount is on the ImmD fee table. Online you can pay by card; by post you need a cashier order or bank draft, never cash.
  7. Wait for the decision. ImmD normally takes about four weeks after it has every document. It will not start on an incomplete file.
  8. Save your e-Visa. On arrival, show your passport and the e-Visa QR code on your phone or a printed A4 copy.

What documents do you need?

  • Completed form ID 1003A with a recent photo attached
  • Copy of your passport's personal details page, with issue and expiry dates
  • Proof of money, such as recent bank statements or tax records
  • Proof of employment if you have a job
  • Flight itinerary or other transport plans
  • Proof of your purpose: a tour itinerary, a business invitation letter, or proof of your relationship with the person you are visiting
  • If sponsored: form ID 1003B plus the company's Business Registration Certificate, or the individual sponsor's Hong Kong ID card copy

Not sure how to write the supporting letter? Our guide to visa cover letters shows what to include. Photo rules are explained in digital photos for visa applications.

How long does a Hong Kong visit visa take?

ImmD says it normally needs about four weeks after it receives all the documents. Apply at least six weeks before you travel so you have time to answer any questions. If ImmD asks for more papers, the clock effectively restarts when they arrive.

What are the most common mistakes?

  • Applying through the wrong channel. If you live outside Hong Kong, use the Chinese mission in the country where you live, unless your nationality is told to apply directly to ImmD.
  • Sending cash by post. Postal fees must be a cashier order or bank draft.
  • Weak proof of money. One bank statement with a large recent deposit raises questions. Three to six months of normal activity reads better.
  • No clear purpose. "Tourism" with no itinerary is harder to approve than a simple day-by-day plan.
  • Faxing only. You may fax forms first, but ImmD only issues the visa after the originals arrive.

Can someone in Hong Kong sponsor you?

Yes. A sponsor can be a Hong Kong company or an individual who is at least 18, lives in Hong Kong as a genuine resident and knows you personally. The sponsor fills in ID 1003B and adds their ID or company papers. Sponsors can also post the whole application to ImmD on your behalf.

How can Alif Visa help?

Alif Visa is a UK-registered visa assistance company. We check your forms, documents and photo before you submit, and help with flight reservations and hotel bookings for your file. ImmD makes every decision; no one can guarantee a visa. For general Hong Kong entry rules, see our Hong Kong visa overview, or check your route.

Frequently asked questions

Is a Hong Kong visa the same as a China visa?

No. Hong Kong has its own immigration rules. A mainland China visa does not let you enter Hong Kong, and a Hong Kong visa does not let you enter mainland China.

Can I apply for a Hong Kong visit visa online?

Yes. ImmD accepts visit and transit visa applications online through GovHK, and you can pay the fee by card.

Do I need a sponsor for a Hong Kong visit visa?

No, a sponsor is optional. It can make your application easier to verify, especially for family or business visits.

Can I work on a Hong Kong visit visa?

No. Visitors may not take paid or unpaid work, start or join a business, or enrol as students.

What does the Hong Kong e-Visa look like?

It is an electronic document with a QR code. Keep it on your phone or print it on A4 paper and show it with your passport at the immigration counter.

Sources

  • Hong Kong Immigration Department: Visit/transit visa
  • ImmD form ID 1003A

title: How Do You Book a Qatar Biometric Appointment at a Qatar Visa Center?
seo_title: Qatar Biometric Appointment: How to Book at a Qatar Visa Center (QVC)
desc: How to book a Qatar biometric appointment at a Qatar Visa Center (QVC): who needs it, the visa reference number, what happens on the day, medical and contract steps.
alt: Doha West Bay skyline in Qatar
faq: Can I book a Qatar Visa Center appointment without a visa reference number?
No. The booking system asks for the visa reference number your employer receives from Qatar's Ministry of Interior.
Is the QVC appointment for tourists?
Generally no. Qatar Visa Centers focus on employment visas. Tourists usually use Qatar's online visa routes or visa-free entry where eligible.
What happens at a Qatar Visa Center?
Your passport and documents are checked, you e-sign your employment contract, your fingerprints and photo are taken, and you complete a medical check.
Can I change my QVC appointment?
Usually yes, through the same official booking website, subject to available slots.
Do I pay to book a QVC appointment?
Check the official Qatar Visa Center website for current fees, and avoid anyone selling appointments.
content:
Short answer: Most people who get a Qatar work visa give their fingerprints and photo at a Qatar Visa Center (QVC) in their home country. Your employer first applies to Qatar's Ministry of Interior and gets a visa reference number. You then book a QVC appointment online with that number, attend in person for biometrics, a medical check and contract signing, and wait for the work visa.

Quick factsDetails
Who runs itQatar Visa Center (QVC), set up by Qatar's Ministry of Interior
Who needs itMainly people coming to Qatar on a work visa from countries with a QVC
What you need to bookVisa reference number from your employer, plus your passport
What happens thereDocument check, e-signing your work contract, fingerprints and photo, medical check
Official sitesqatarvisacenter.com and moi.gov.qa (Metrash app)

What is a Qatar biometric appointment?

A biometric appointment is a short in-person visit where your fingerprints and photo are recorded for your Qatar visa. Qatar moved this step to Qatar Visa Centers in workers' home countries, so most checks are finished before you fly. That means you can usually start work soon after you land.

Who needs to go to a Qatar Visa Center?

QVCs mainly handle employment visas. The first centres opened from 2018 in countries that send many workers to Qatar, including Sri Lanka, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, the Philippines, Indonesia and Tunisia. More locations have opened since. If your employer tells you to "complete QVC", this is the process they mean. Visitors and tourists usually apply online instead; see our Qatar visa guide.

How do you book a Qatar biometric appointment, step by step?

  1. Your employer applies first. The employer submits your work visa application through the Ministry of Interior website or the Metrash app.
  2. Get your visa reference number. Once the Ministry gives initial approval, your employer sends you the reference number.
  3. Book online. Go to the official Qatar Visa Center website, choose your country and nearest centre, enter your visa reference number and passport number, and pick a date.
  4. Print or save the confirmation. Bring it with your original passport on the day.
  5. Attend the appointment. Staff check your passport and documents, show you your employment contract to read and e-sign, then take your fingerprints and photo.
  6. Do the medical check at the medical section linked to the centre.
  7. Wait for your employer. When everything clears, your employer receives the work visa and tells you.

What should you bring?

  • Original passport, valid for at least six months
  • Your visa reference number and appointment confirmation
  • Any documents your employer or the centre asks for, such as educational certificates or experience letters for skilled jobs
  • Passport-size photos if requested (see our visa photo guide)

Requirements differ by job and nationality, so always follow the checklist your employer and the centre send you.

Read your contract before you sign

At the QVC you e-sign your employment contract, usually in English and your own language. Check the job title, salary, working hours and allowances match what you were offered. You receive a copy at the end. If something is wrong, raise it with your employer before you finish the process.

What are the most common problems?

  • Booking before the reference number is active. Wait until your employer confirms initial approval.
  • Using agents who sell appointments. Booking through the official site is the safe route. Never pay strangers for a "guaranteed slot".
  • Name mismatches between your passport and the employer's application. Ask your employer to fix them first.
  • Missing the medical step. Your visa cannot be issued until the medical check is complete.

How long does the Qatar visa take after biometrics?

It depends on your medical results and your employer's processing. Many applicants hear back within a few weeks, but there is no fixed official time. Our Qatar processing time guide covers the online visa routes.

How can Alif Visa help?

We help applicants understand each step, check documents and prepare files. For a work visa, your employer must start the application with Qatar's Ministry of Interior. If you're unsure where you stand, talk to our team or check your route.

Frequently asked questions

Can I book a Qatar Visa Center appointment without a visa reference number?

No. The booking system asks for the visa reference number your employer receives from Qatar's Ministry of Interior.

Is the QVC appointment for tourists?

Generally no. QVCs focus on employment visas. Tourists and short-term visitors usually use Qatar's online visa routes or visa-free entry where eligible.

What happens at a Qatar Visa Center?

Your passport and documents are checked, you e-sign your employment contract, your fingerprints and photo are taken, and you complete a medical check.

Can I change my QVC appointment?

Usually yes, through the same official booking website, subject to available slots.

Do I pay to book a QVC appointment?

Check the official Qatar Visa Center website for current fees, and avoid anyone selling appointments.

Sources

  • Qatar Visa Center (official)
  • Qatar Ministry of Interior
  • The Peninsula: Ministry explains employment visa procedures through QVC

title: How Do You Check Your Sweden Visa Application Status?
seo_title: How to Check Your Sweden Visa Status (Visitor and Schengen Visa)
desc: How to check the status of a Sweden visitor (Schengen) visa: tracking through VFS Global, when the embassy decides, normal waiting times and what to do if it takes longer.
alt: Stockholm old town waterfront in Sweden
faq: Can I check my Sweden visa status online?
Yes. Use the tracking page of the visa centre where you applied, usually VFS Global, with your reference number and date of birth.
Does Migrationsverket show Schengen visitor visa status?
Normally no. Visitor visas are decided by the embassy and tracked through the visa centre. Migrationsverket e-services are for residence permits.
How long does a Sweden Schengen visa take?
Usually up to 15 calendar days after a complete application, and up to 45 days in some cases.
What does processed at embassy mean?
The embassy has made a decision and your passport is on its way back to the visa centre. You find out the result when you collect it.
Can I travel while my passport is at the embassy?
No, not unless you have a second valid passport. Plan your application so you don't need your passport during processing.
content:
Short answer: If you applied for a Sweden visitor (Schengen) visa through a visa centre such as VFS Global, you track it on that centre's website with your reference number and date of birth. The Swedish embassy or consulate makes the decision. Most short-stay visa decisions are made within 15 calendar days, but it can take up to 45 days if more checks are needed.

Quick factsDetails
Who decides visitor visasThe Swedish embassy or consulate (or a country representing Sweden)
Where to trackThe visa centre where you applied, usually VFS Global
What you needYour reference/tracking number and date of birth
Normal decision time15 calendar days, up to 45 in some cases
Residence permitsHandled by the Swedish Migration Agency (Migrationsverket), tracked in its own e-services

What does "visa status" mean?

Your visa status shows where your passport and application are: received at the visa centre, sent to the embassy, decision made, or ready to collect. It does not usually say whether the visa was approved until your passport is back, so "decision made" can mean either outcome.

How do you check a Sweden visitor visa status, step by step?

  1. Find your reference number. It is on the receipt or email the visa centre gave you when you submitted biometrics.
  2. Open the visa centre's tracking page. For VFS Global, go to the Sweden page for the country where you applied and choose "Track your application".
  3. Enter your details exactly as on the receipt: reference number and date of birth (some countries also ask for your surname).
  4. Read the stage. Typical stages are "received at centre", "forwarded to embassy", "processed at embassy" and "ready for collection" or "dispatched by courier".
  5. Turn on SMS or email updates if the centre offers them, so you don't need to keep checking.

How long does a Sweden visitor visa take?

Under the EU Visa Code, consulates aim to decide short-stay visas within 15 calendar days of a complete application. In busy seasons or when extra checks are needed, this can stretch to 45 days. Apply early: you can submit up to six months before your trip, and at least 15 days before. For other timings, see our Sweden visa guide.

What if your status hasn't changed for weeks?

  • Check you're on the right site. Sweden uses different visa centres in different countries.
  • Look for emails asking for documents. Delays often mean the embassy is waiting for something from you.
  • Contact the visa centre first for tracking issues. They can see the courier and handover status.
  • Contact the embassy only if you are well past 15 days and the centre cannot help. Have your reference number ready.

Is a residence permit tracked the same way?

No. Work, study and family residence permits are decided by the Swedish Migration Agency (Migrationsverket). If you applied online, you follow your case by logging into its e-services with your case number. That is a different system from Schengen visitor visas.

What happens after the decision?

You collect your passport or receive it by courier. If approved, check the visa sticker: your name, passport number, dates, number of entries and days allowed. If refused, the refusal form lists the reason and how to appeal. Many refusals come from weak proof of money or unclear travel plans. Our guides on cover letters and Schengen applications help with a stronger reapplication.

How can Alif Visa help?

We prepare and check Schengen visa files before submission, help book appointments, and arrange travel insurance that meets Schengen rules. The decision always belongs to the embassy. Already applied with us? Use Track application to see our stage.

Frequently asked questions

Can I check my Sweden visa status online?

Yes. Use the tracking page of the visa centre where you applied, usually VFS Global, with your reference number and date of birth.

Does Migrationsverket show Schengen visitor visa status?

Normally no. Visitor visas are decided by the embassy and tracked through the visa centre. Migrationsverket e-services are for residence permits.

How long does a Sweden Schengen visa take?

Usually up to 15 calendar days after a complete application, and up to 45 days in some cases.

What does "processed at embassy" mean?

The embassy has made a decision and your passport is on its way back to the visa centre. You find out the result when you collect it.

Can I travel while my passport is at the embassy?

No, not unless you have a second valid passport. Plan your application so you don't need your passport during processing.

Sources

  • Sweden Abroad (Swedish embassies)
  • Swedish Migration Agency: Visiting Sweden
  • European Commission: Applying for a Schengen visa

title: How Do You Book a BLS Visa Appointment?
seo_title: BLS Appointment: How to Book a BLS International Visa Appointment
desc: How to book a BLS International visa appointment, mainly for Spain: create an account, choose your centre, pay, and what to bring. Plus how to avoid fake booking agents.
faq: Is BLS the Spanish embassy?
No. BLS International is a private company that collects applications for the embassy. The embassy or consulate makes the visa decision.
Is booking a BLS appointment free?
Yes, on the official BLS website. You pay the visa fee and BLS service fee when you submit your application.
Can I reschedule my BLS appointment?
Usually yes, through your account on the same website, depending on available slots and local rules.
Which countries use BLS International?
BLS works for several governments and is best known for Spain visa applications in many countries. Check your destination embassy's website to see who handles applications where you live.
Can I apply at any BLS centre?
No. You must use the centre that covers the area where you legally live.
content:
Short answer: BLS International is a private company that collects visa applications for some governments, most often Spain. To book a BLS appointment, open the official BLS website for your country and the embassy you are applying to, create an account, fill in the application details, choose a centre and time slot, and print the appointment letter. Booking on the official site is free; you pay the official fees when you submit.

Quick factsDetails
What BLS isA visa application centre company working for embassies
Best known forSpain visa applications in many countries, including the UK and UAE
Who decides your visaThe embassy or consulate, not BLS
Booking costFree on the official BLS site; visa and service fees are paid at submission
What to bringAppointment letter, passport, completed form, photo and supporting documents

What is a BLS appointment?

A BLS appointment is a booked time at a BLS International visa application centre where you hand in your visa documents and give your fingerprints and photo. BLS only collects and returns your application. The embassy decides whether you get the visa.

How do you book a BLS appointment, step by step?

  1. Confirm BLS handles your application. Check the embassy's website for the country you're visiting. It will say whether it uses BLS, VFS Global, TLScontact or its own office.
  2. Open the official BLS site for your country of residence. Spain applications in the UK, for example, have their own BLS UK site.
  3. Create an account with your email and phone number. Many BLS sites now link each appointment to your passport number.
  4. Choose your visa category (tourism, business, family visit, study and so on) and fill in your details.
  5. Pick the centre for your area. Embassies split countries into jurisdictions, so you must use the centre that covers where you live.
  6. Select a date and time, then confirm.
  7. Print the appointment letter or save it on your phone, and bring it with your original documents.

What should you bring to a BLS appointment?

  • Appointment confirmation letter
  • Passport valid for at least three months after your trip, with two blank pages, plus copies
  • Completed and signed visa application form
  • Recent passport photo that meets Schengen rules (see our visa photo guide)
  • Proof of residence in the country where you apply, if you're not a citizen
  • Flight reservation, hotel booking or invitation, travel insurance, bank statements and a cover letter
  • Payment for the visa fee and BLS service fee

Can a travel agent book BLS appointments for you?

It depends on the country. In the UAE, BLS announced in July 2026 that Spain visa appointments must be self-booked, are tied to the applicant's passport, and appointments obtained through agents are not accepted. Wherever you live, be careful with anyone selling "guaranteed" slots. BLS says booking on its website is free.

What if there are no BLS appointments available?

  • Check early in the morning and at the start of each week, when new slots often open.
  • Look at other centres in your jurisdiction, if you're allowed to use them.
  • Apply earlier: Schengen visas can be requested up to six months before travel.
  • Never buy appointments from unofficial websites or social media sellers.

How do you track your application after the appointment?

Use the tracking tool on the same BLS website with your reference number. When your passport is ready, collect it or receive it by courier. If you were refused, the refusal letter explains why and how to appeal.

How can Alif Visa help?

We help you choose the right visa category, check your documents, and prepare the file before your BLS appointment. We also arrange travel insurance, flight reservations and hotel bookings for your application. See our Spain visa guide or visa appointment service.

Frequently asked questions

Is BLS the Spanish embassy?

No. BLS International is a private company that collects applications for the embassy. The embassy or consulate makes the visa decision.

Is booking a BLS appointment free?

Yes, on the official BLS website. You pay the visa fee and BLS service fee when you submit your application.

Can I reschedule my BLS appointment?

Usually yes, through your account on the same website, depending on available slots and local rules.

Which countries use BLS International?

BLS works for several governments. It is best known for Spain visa applications in many countries. Check your destination embassy's website to see who handles applications where you live.

Can I apply at any BLS centre?

No. You must use the centre that covers the area where you legally live.

title: What Size Is an Australia Visa Photo?
seo_title: Australia Visa Photo Size and Requirements (35 x 45 mm Guide)
desc: Australia visa photo size and rules: 35-40 mm wide by 45-50 mm high for paper forms, plus how to upload a digital photo in ImmiAccount and avoid common rejections.
alt: Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge in Australia
faq: Is a 35 x 45 mm photo OK for an Australian visa?
Yes. A standard 35 x 45 mm passport photo fits within the 35-40 mm by 45-50 mm range for printed photos.
Can I take my Australia visa photo with a phone?
Yes, if it is sharp, evenly lit, against a plain light background, and taken by someone else rather than as a selfie.
Do I need a printed photo for an online visitor visa?
Usually no. For online applications in ImmiAccount you upload a digital photo instead.
Can I wear glasses in my visa photo?
It is best not to. If you must, the lenses must be clear with no glare, and your eyes fully visible.
Can I use my passport photo again?
Only if it was taken in the last six months and still looks like you.
content:
Short answer: For paper Australian visa forms, use a passport-style photo 35 to 40 mm wide and 45 to 50 mm high, in colour, taken in the last six months, with a plain light background and your face clearly visible. Most visas are now applied for online in ImmiAccount, where you upload a clear digital photo or scan instead of posting a printed one.

Quick factsDetails
Printed photo size35-40 mm wide x 45-50 mm high
Age of photoTaken in the last 6 months
BackgroundPlain, light-coloured, no shadows
ExpressionNeutral, mouth closed, eyes open, looking at the camera
Online applicationsUpload a clear digital photo in ImmiAccount

What is an Australia visa photo?

It is a recent passport-style photo of your face that the Department of Home Affairs uses to identify you. For most online visas, such as the visitor visa (subclass 600), you upload it as a file with your application. Some paper forms and in-person services still ask for printed photos.

What are the Australia visa photo requirements?

  • Size (printed): 35-40 mm wide and 45-50 mm high. A standard 35 x 45 mm photo meets this.
  • Head size: your face should fill most of the frame, from chin to top of head roughly 32-36 mm.
  • Recent: taken within the last six months.
  • Colour: no black-and-white photos, no filters or beauty edits.
  • Background: plain and light, such as white or light grey, with no patterns or other people.
  • Pose: face the camera directly, neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open.
  • Glasses: avoid them if you can. If you must wear them, no glare and no tinted lenses.
  • Head coverings: only for religious or medical reasons, and your full face must be visible.

How do you upload a photo in ImmiAccount, step by step?

  1. Take the photo against a plain wall in good daylight, with no shadows on your face or the background.
  2. Check it on a computer. Your whole face and the top of your shoulders should be visible and sharp.
  3. Save it as a JPG under the size limit shown on the upload screen.
  4. Log in to ImmiAccount, open your application and go to the attachments section.
  5. Choose the photo document type (for example "Photograph - Passport") and upload the file.
  6. Submit and keep a copy of the photo for future applications.

Want more detail on digital photos? Read digital photos for visa and eVisa forms.

What are the most common photo mistakes?

  • A selfie taken at arm's length, which distorts the face
  • Shadows behind the head or across the face
  • A cropped photo where the chin or hair is cut off
  • An old photo that no longer looks like you
  • Smiling widely, tilting the head, or wearing sunglasses or a hat
  • Uploading a photo of a printed photo, which looks blurry

Do children need the same photo?

Yes, the same rules apply. For babies, a plain light sheet behind them works well. Their eyes should be open if possible, and no hands or toys should be in the shot.

How can Alif Visa help?

We check your photo and documents before you apply, so small problems don't slow your visa down. See our Australia tourist visa guide and Australia visa overview, or check your route.

Frequently asked questions

Is a 35 x 45 mm photo OK for an Australian visa?

Yes. A standard 35 x 45 mm passport photo fits within the 35-40 mm by 45-50 mm range for printed photos.

Can I take my Australia visa photo with a phone?

Yes, if it's sharp, evenly lit, against a plain light background, and taken by someone else rather than as a selfie.

Do I need a printed photo for an online visitor visa?

Usually no. For online applications in ImmiAccount you upload a digital photo instead.

Can I wear glasses in my visa photo?

It's best not to. If you must, the lenses must be clear with no glare, and your eyes fully visible.

Can I use my passport photo again?

Only if it was taken in the last six months and still looks like you.

  • Australian Passport Office: photo guidelines

title: Do British Citizens Need a Visa for Azerbaijan?
seo_title: Azerbaijan Visa for British Citizens: e-Visa (ASAN) Guide
desc: Yes, British citizens need a visa for Azerbaijan, usually an e-visa (ASAN Visa) applied online before travel. Steps, stay length, registration and common mistakes.
alt: Flame Towers on the Baku skyline in Azerbaijan
faq: Can British citizens get a visa on arrival in Azerbaijan?
Plan to get your e-visa before you fly. Visa-on-arrival rules are limited and can change, so the online e-visa is the reliable option.
How long does the Azerbaijan e-visa take?
Standard processing usually takes a few working days, and urgent processing is faster for an extra fee. Apply at least a week before travel.
Is the ASAN Visa the same as the e-visa?
Yes. ASAN Visa is the name of Azerbaijan's official electronic visa system.
Can I work in Azerbaijan on an e-visa?
No. The e-visa is for tourism, business meetings and short visits only.
Do children need their own e-visa?
Yes. Every traveller, including children, needs their own visa.
content:
Short answer: Yes. British citizens need a visa to visit Azerbaijan. Most travellers get an electronic visa (often called the ASAN Visa) online from the official Azerbaijan e-visa portal before they fly. A standard e-visa is single-entry and allows a stay of up to 30 days. Apply only through the official government site, and allow at least a few working days.

Quick factsDetails
Visa needed?Yes, for British citizens
Easiest optione-Visa (ASAN Visa) through evisa.gov.az
Typical stayUp to 30 days, single entry
PassportValid beyond your stay; check current validity rules before you apply
RegistrationRequired for longer stays; your hotel normally does it

What is the Azerbaijan e-visa (ASAN Visa)?

The ASAN Visa is Azerbaijan's online tourist and short-visit visa. You apply on the official portal, pay by card and receive the visa by email as a PDF. Print it or keep it on your phone, and show it with your passport at the border. It replaces the need to visit an embassy for most short trips.

How do British citizens apply for an Azerbaijan e-visa, step by step?

  1. Check your passport. It should be valid for well beyond your planned departure date and in good condition.
  2. Go to the official portal, evisa.gov.az. Look-alike websites charge extra and some are scams.
  3. Fill in the form with your passport details, travel dates and the address where you'll stay.
  4. Upload a passport scan of the photo page.
  5. Choose standard or urgent processing and pay by card. Current fees are shown on the portal before you pay.
  6. Receive your e-visa by email and check every detail matches your passport.
  7. Travel with a printed copy or a copy on your phone, plus your return ticket and accommodation details.

How long can you stay in Azerbaijan?

A standard e-visa usually allows one entry and a stay of up to 30 days within the visa's validity window. If you need longer or several entries, apply for a different visa through the Embassy of Azerbaijan in London.

Do you need to register in Azerbaijan?

Foreign visitors staying longer than a set number of days (currently 15) must register their address with the State Migration Service. If you stay in a hotel, the hotel normally registers you. If you stay in a private flat or with friends, your host or you must do it. Check the current rule before you travel, because missing registration can lead to a fine.

What should UK residents who are not British citizens do?

Your visa rules depend on your passport, not where you live. Many nationalities can use the same e-visa portal; some need to apply through an embassy. Our Azerbaijan visa guide explains the options by nationality.

What are the most common mistakes?

  • Applying on unofficial websites that charge high "service fees"
  • Typos in the passport number or name, which make the e-visa invalid
  • Arriving before the visa's start date
  • Forgetting address registration on longer stays
  • Overstaying, which can lead to fines and future refusals

How can Alif Visa help?

We can check your details before you apply, or prepare your e-visa application for you. Read more about the ASAN e-visa, see the UK government's official information sources, or check your route.

Frequently asked questions

Can British citizens get a visa on arrival in Azerbaijan?

Plan to get your e-visa before you fly. Visa-on-arrival rules are limited and can change, so the online e-visa is the reliable option.

How long does the Azerbaijan e-visa take?

Standard processing usually takes a few working days, and urgent processing is faster for an extra fee. Apply at least a week before travel to be safe.

Is the ASAN Visa the same as the e-visa?

Yes. ASAN Visa is the name of Azerbaijan's official electronic visa system.

Can I work in Azerbaijan on an e-visa?

No. The e-visa is for tourism, business meetings and short visits only.

Do children need their own e-visa?

Yes. Every traveller, including children, needs their own visa.

title: Do British Citizens and UK Residents Need a Visa for Bahrain?

desc: British citizens need a visa for Bahrain but can get it online (eVisa), from the embassy or on arrival. What UK residents of other nationalities should do, and how to apply.

Yes. GOV.UK lists visa on arrival as an option for British citizens, alongside the eVisa and the embassy.

Many applications are decided within a few working days. Apply at least a week before travel.

Can I work in Bahrain on a visit visa?
No. You need a work visa and permit arranged through an employer.

content:
Short answer: Yes, British citizens need a visa for Bahrain, but it's easy to get. You can apply online through Bahrain's official eVisa portal, get one from the Bahrain Embassy in London, or get a visa on arrival. GOV.UK says a standard visa is issued for two weeks, and visit visas of up to six months are available. UK residents with other passports follow the rules for their own nationality.

Quick factsDetails
Visa needed?Yes, for British citizens
How to get iteVisa online (evisa.gov.bh), Bahrain Embassy in the UK, or on arrival
Standard stay2 weeks; visit visas up to 6 months available
Passport validityAt least 6 months from arrival
Work allowed?No, not on a visit visa

What is the Bahrain eVisa?

The Bahrain eVisa is an online visit visa issued by Bahrain's Nationality, Passports and Residence Affairs (NPRA). You apply on the official portal, upload your documents, pay by card and receive the approval by email. It saves time at the airport compared with a visa on arrival.

How do British citizens get a Bahrain visa, step by step?

  1. Check your passport is valid for at least six months from the day you arrive.
  2. Choose your option: eVisa online, the embassy, or visa on arrival.
  3. For the eVisa, go to evisa.gov.bh, pick the visit visa type that matches your trip and length of stay, and fill in the form.
  4. Upload documents, usually a passport scan and photo, and sometimes a return ticket and hotel booking.
  5. Pay the fee shown on the portal.
  6. Print or save the approval and carry it with your passport.

What about UK residents who aren't British citizens?

Bahrain sets visa rules by nationality. Many nationalities can use the eVisa portal; others need a sponsor or an embassy application. Some nationalities may have easier eVisa options if they hold certain residence permits or visas. Check the eVisa portal's eligibility tool with your own passport, or see our Bahrain visa guide.

How long can you stay?

GOV.UK says a standard visa is issued automatically for two weeks. If you need longer, choose a longer visit visa (up to six months is available) or apply to extend through the NPRA before your visa ends.

What are the most common mistakes?

  • Passport with less than six months' validity
  • Choosing the wrong visa length for your trip
  • Applying through unofficial websites with extra charges
  • Planning to work on a visit visa, which isn't allowed
  • Overstaying, which can bring penalties and problems on future visits

Can you visit Bahrain and Saudi Arabia on one trip?

Yes, but each country needs its own visa. Many travellers cross the King Fahd Causeway between the two. Plan both visas before you go.

title: Do British Citizens Need a Visa for Brazil?
seo_title: Brazil Visa for British Citizens: Visa-Free Rules and Who Needs One
desc: British citizens can visit Brazil without a visa for up to 90 days for tourism. Passport rules, extensions, and what UK residents with other passports need.
alt: Rio de Janeiro bay with Sugarloaf Mountain in Brazil
faq: Do UK citizens need an e-visa for Brazil?
No. British citizens can visit Brazil visa-free for up to 90 days for tourism.
Can I extend my stay in Brazil?
You can ask the Federal Police before your 90 days end. They decide whether an extension is possible.
What happens if I overstay in Brazil?
You will pay a daily fine, either when you leave or on your next visit.
Do dual British-Brazilian nationals need a Brazilian passport?
Brazilian immigration often requires dual nationals to enter and leave on a Brazilian passport.
Can I do business in Brazil without a visa?
Short business visits may be allowed, but paid work needs a visa. Check with the Brazilian consulate for your exact activity.
content:
Short answer: No. British citizens can visit Brazil without a visa for up to 90 days for tourism. You need a passport valid for at least six months after you arrive, and you should make sure the border officer stamps it. If you want to work, study or stay longer, you need the right Brazilian visa. UK residents with other passports follow the rules for their nationality.

Quick factsDetails
Visa needed for tourism?No, for British citizens
Visa-free stayUp to 90 days
Passport validityAt least 6 months after arrival
Extending your stayAsk the Federal Police before your 90 days end
Work or studyNeeds a Brazilian visa

What does visa-free mean for Brazil?

Visa-free means you don't apply for anything before you fly. You show your passport at the border and are admitted as a visitor. You still need to meet entry conditions: a valid passport, a genuine visit, and enough money and plans for your stay.

What do British citizens need to enter Brazil?

  • A British passport valid for at least six months after your arrival date
  • A passport that has not been reported lost or stolen
  • A return or onward ticket and accommodation details, in case you're asked
  • A passport stamp on arrival; if you don't get one, you may be fined when you leave
  • Check vaccine advice (such as yellow fever for some regions) on TravelHealthPro

How do you stay longer than 90 days?

Contact Brazil's Federal Police (Polícia Federal) before your 90 days end to ask about an extension. If you overstay, you pay a daily fine when you leave or on your next visit, which can make future trips harder.

What if you're a UK resident but not a British citizen?

Brazil's rules depend on your passport. Some nationalities are visa-free, and others need a visa or e-visa before travel. For example, Brazil reintroduced visa requirements for some nationalities in recent years. Check your passport on the Brazilian consulate's website or our Brazil visa guide before booking.

Do you need a visa to work or study in Brazil?

Yes. Visa-free entry is for tourism and similar short visits. Work, study, research and long stays need the right Brazilian visa, usually applied for through the Consulate General of Brazil in London.

What are the most common mistakes?

  • Travelling with a passport that expires within six months
  • Not checking for a stamp at the border
  • Assuming the 90-day rule covers business work or paid projects
  • Dual British-Brazilian nationals entering on the British passport, when Brazil often expects the Brazilian one
  • Children travelling without the required parental authorisation

title: Do British Citizens Need a Visa for Cambodia?
seo_title: Cambodia Visa for British Citizens: e-Visa or Visa on Arrival
desc: Yes, British citizens need a visa for Cambodia. Get an e-visa online at least 4 days ahead or a visa on arrival. Stay length, e-Arrival Card and common mistakes.
faq: How long does a Cambodia e-visa take?
Apply at least four days before you travel. Many e-visas arrive sooner, but do not leave it to the last minute.
Can I extend a Cambodia tourist visa?
Yes, a tourist visa can be extended while you are in Cambodia.
Do I need US dollars for a visa on arrival?
Yes. The visa on arrival fee is paid in US dollars, so bring the right amount in cash.
What is the Cambodia e-Arrival Card?
A free online form you complete within seven days before flying into Phnom Penh, Siem Reap or Sihanoukville.
Can I work in Cambodia on a tourist visa?
No. You need a business visa and a work permit, arranged with your employer.
content:
Short answer: Yes. British citizens need a visa to visit Cambodia. The easiest way is an e-visa from the official Cambodian e-visa website or app, applied for at least four days before you travel. You can also get a visa on arrival at airports and land borders, paid in US dollars. A tourist visa allows 30 days from the date you enter and can be extended inside Cambodia.

Quick factsDetails
Visa needed?Yes, for British citizens
OptionsOfficial e-visa (online or app) or visa on arrival
Apply e-visaAt least 4 days before travel
Tourist stay30 days from entry, extendable in Cambodia
Passport validityAt least 6 months from arrival, undamaged
e-Arrival CardFree, required for arrivals by air at main airports

What is the Cambodia e-visa?

The Cambodia e-visa is an online tourist visa from the Cambodian government. You apply on the official website or app, pay by card and receive the visa by email. It's valid for 30 days from the day you enter.

How do British citizens get a Cambodia e-visa, step by step?

  1. Check your passport is valid for six months from arrival and not damaged. Cambodia normally refuses entry on damaged passports.
  2. Use the official e-visa website or app, linked from the Royal Embassy of Cambodia in the UK.
  3. Fill in your details and upload a recent passport-style photo.
  4. Pay the fee shown on the official site.
  5. Wait at least four days before your trip for the visa to arrive by email.
  6. Print two copies and carry them with your passport.
  7. Complete the free e-Arrival Card within seven days before you fly into Phnom Penh, Siem Reap or Sihanoukville.

Can you get a visa on arrival instead?

Yes. If you don't get an e-visa, you can get a visa on arrival at international airports and land border crossings. Bring a passport photo and the fee in US dollars cash. Queues can be long at busy times, so the e-visa is quicker.

What else do you need to know?

  • Keep your departure form from arrival. If you lose it, contact immigration before you leave.
  • Registration: hotels register you automatically. If you stay with friends or family, you must register yourself on the official FPCS app.
  • Working needs a business visa and a work permit.
  • Overstaying brings fines with no upper limit, possible detention and deportation.

What should UK residents with other passports do?

Cambodia's rules depend on nationality. Some ASEAN nationals don't need a visa, while most others can use the e-visa. Check your passport on the official e-visa site or our Cambodia visa guide.

What are the most common mistakes?

  • Using look-alike websites that charge extra
  • Applying too late (fewer than four days before travel)
  • A damaged passport, which can mean refused entry
  • Forgetting the free e-Arrival Card
  • Overstaying the 30 days

title: How Do UK Residents Apply for a Belgium Visa?
seo_title: Belgium Visa for UK Residents: Schengen Visa via TLScontact
desc: UK residents who need a Schengen visa for Belgium apply at a TLScontact centre in London, Edinburgh or Manchester. Who needs one, documents, steps and the 3-day address rule.
faq: Can I apply for a Belgian visa at the embassy in London?
No. Short-stay visa applications go through TLScontact visa application centres, not the embassy.
Which TLScontact centre should I use?
Use the centre that covers where you live: London, Edinburgh or Manchester.
How long can I stay on a Belgian Schengen visa?
Up to 90 days in any 180-day period, depending on the dates and entries on your visa.
Do I need to register when I arrive in Belgium?
Yes, visitors must declare their presence within three days. From 10 April 2026 this can be done online through My Address in Belgium. Hotels usually handle it for guests.

content:
Short answer: If you live in the UK and your passport needs a Schengen visa, you apply for a Belgian short-stay visa at a TLScontact visa application centre in London, Edinburgh or Manchester, not at the embassy. Book online, bring your documents and UK residence proof, and give fingerprints. British citizens don't need a visa for short visits, but they'll need ETIAS travel authorisation once it starts.

Quick factsDetails
Who needs itUK residents whose nationality needs a Schengen visa
Where to applyTLScontact centres in London, Edinburgh or Manchester
Who decidesThe Embassy of Belgium in London
Maximum stayUp to 90 days in any 180-day period
After arrivalDeclare your presence within 3 days (online via My Address in Belgium from 10 April 2026)

What is a Belgium Schengen visa?

A Belgian short-stay visa is a Schengen visa issued by Belgium. It lets you stay up to 90 days in any 180-day period for tourism, family visits or business, and travel to other Schengen countries during that time. Apply to Belgium if it's your main destination, or your first entry point when all stays are equal.

Do UK residents need a visa for Belgium?

It depends on your passport. British citizens can visit visa-free for short stays. If you hold another passport, such as Indian, Pakistani, Nigerian or Chinese, and live in the UK, you normally need a Schengen visa. Your UK residence permit should be valid for at least three months after you plan to leave the Schengen area. Our Schengen visa from the UK guide explains this in detail.

How do you apply, step by step?

  1. Check you need a visa and that Belgium is your main destination.
  2. Create an account on the TLScontact Belgium (UK) website and fill in the application.
  3. Book an appointment at the centre covering your area: London, Edinburgh or Manchester.
  4. Prepare your documents (list below) using the TLScontact checklist.
  5. Attend the appointment, hand in your file and passport, give fingerprints and pay the fees.
  6. Track your application on TLScontact and collect your passport when it's ready.
  7. Declare your presence within three days of arriving in Belgium. From 10 April 2026 this can be done online via "My Address in Belgium".

What documents do you need?

  • Passport valid for at least three months after your return, with two blank pages, issued in the last 10 years
  • UK residence permit (BRP, eVisa share code or similar) and proof you live in the UK
  • Completed application form and a recent photo (see our photo guide)
  • Travel insurance with at least €30,000 medical cover for the Schengen area
  • Flight and hotel bookings, or an invitation from your host in Belgium
  • Recent bank statements and an employment or study letter
  • A short cover letter explaining your trip

The embassy decides on the file you submit, so send complete documents the first time.

How long does it take?

Schengen consulates aim to decide within 15 calendar days of a complete application, sometimes longer at busy times. You can apply up to six months before travel. Apply at least three to four weeks ahead to leave time for appointments.

What about British citizens and ETIAS?

British citizens don't need a visa for short visits to Belgium. When the EU's ETIAS travel authorisation starts, they'll need to apply online before travelling. See our ETIAS guide.

Up to 90 days in any 180-day period, depending on the dates and entries on your visa.

Yes, visitors must declare their presence within three days. From 10 April 2026 this can be done online through "My Address in Belgium". Hotels usually handle it for guests.
